shots.content: Inside a seminar room, a rectangular worktable stands between a pinboard and the entrance, with windows along one side; a clear aisle runs opposite the window. A man in a purple shirt sits in the entrance-side window seat and asserts that basic everyday skills qualify a person as accomplished. A woman in a green shirt sits in the pinboard-side aisle seat. A woman in an orange shirt sits in the entrance-side aisle seat. There is one empty place.
shots.viewpoint: Wide establishing shot from just beside the entrance end, looking along the worktable toward the pinboard, with both window-side seats and both aisle-side seats and the pinboard in frame.

shots.content: A man in a red shirt enters and sits in the empty place. He argues that true accomplishment requires extensive intellectual mastery, and a man in a purple shirt asks for clarification on that standard.
shots.viewpoint: Medium two-shot from the aisle side, centered on the two adjacent window-side seats.

shots.content: A woman in an orange shirt observes that such an exacting standard makes accomplishment exceedingly rare, and a man in a purple shirt replies in agreement.
shots.viewpoint: Top-down wide shot directly above the worktable.
